name: ShellState (primary flags)
comment: ShellState under HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced is a little-endian REG_BINARY value holding a DWORD size followed by the 32 byte SHELLSTATE structure. This definition describes the first bitfield at offset 0x04, which carries the seventeen BOOL members from fShowAllObjects through fNoNetCrawling. Bits 17 to 31 are padding. Where the same setting also has its own value under Explorer\Advanced, Explorer uses the Advanced value, so change both when editing by hand.

fields.name: fShowAllObjects
fields.meaning: Show hidden objects. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\Hidden when that value is 1.

fields.name: fShowExtensions
fields.meaning: Show file extensions. Mirrored inverted by Explorer\Advanced\HideFileExt.

fields.name: fNoConfirmRecycle
fields.meaning: Skip the recycle bin confirmation prompt.

fields.name: fShowSysFiles
fields.meaning: Show system files. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\Hidden when that value is greater than 1.

fields.name: fShowCompColor
fields.meaning: Show compressed and encrypted files in color. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\ShowCompColor.

fields.name: fDoubleClickInWebView
fields.meaning: Require a double click to open an item instead of a single click.

fields.name: fWin95Classic
fields.meaning: Enforce Windows 95 shell behaviour and restrictions.

fields.name: fDontPrettyPath
fields.meaning: Prevent paths from being converted to lowercase. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\DontPrettyPath.

fields.name: fMapNetDrvBtn
fields.meaning: Show the map network drive button. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\MapNetDrvBtn.

fields.name: fShowInfoTip
fields.meaning: Show item popup descriptions. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\ShowInfoTip.

fields.name: fHideIcons
fields.meaning: Hide desktop icons. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\HideIcons.

fields.name: fWebView
fields.meaning: Use web view. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\WebView.

fields.name: fShowSuperHidden
fields.meaning: Show protected operating system files. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\ShowSuperHidden.

fields.name: fNoNetCrawling
fields.meaning: Disable automatic searches for network folders and printers. Mirrored by Explorer\Advanced\NoNetCrawling.
